species.summary: Diadema setosum is a species of long-spined sea urchin belonging to the family Diadematidae. It is a typical sea urchin, with extremely long, hollow spines that are mildly venomous. D. setosum differs from other Diadema with five, characteristic white dots that can be found on its body.
Goniobranchus kuniei is a species of very colourful sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Chromodorididae.
Prosotas nora, the common lineblue, is a species of lycaenid butterfly found in Asia.
Asota heliconia is a moth in the Erebidae family. It is found from the Indo-Australian tropics east to Queensland and the Solomons.

Graphium doson, the common jay, is a black, tropical papilionid (swallowtail) butterfly with pale blue semi-transparent central wing bands that are formed by large spots. There is a marginal series of smaller spots. The underside of wings is brown with markings similar to upperside but whitish in colour.

Theretra oldenlandiae, the impatiens hawkmoth or taro hornworm, is a member of the family Sphingidae found in India, Sri Lanka, China, Borneo, Japan, the Philippines, Thailand, and Australia. It was described by Johan Christian Fabricius in 1775.
Hypolimnas anomala, the Malayan eggfly or crow eggfly (Chinese: 畸紋紫斑蛺蝶) is a species of eggfly.

The sebae anemone (Radianthus crispa), also known as leathery sea anemone, long tentacle anemone, or purple tip anemone, is a species of sea anemone in the family Stichodactylidae and native to the Indo-Pacific.
The palm weevil Rhynchophorus vulneratus is one of two species of snout beetle known as the red palm weevil or Asian palm weevil.
Hypolycaena erylus, the common tit, is a small but striking butterfly found in India and South-East Asia that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.

Coelophora inaequalis, the variable ladybird, common Australian lady beetle or common Australian ladybug is a ladybird species endemic to Australia, Oceania and Southern Asia. The variable ladybird gets its name from the black markings on the adult elytra, that vary from one individual to another.
Samla bicolor is a species of sea slug, an aeolid nudibranch, a marine heterobranch mollusc in the family Samlidae.
Dardanus megistos, the white-spotted hermit crab or spotted hermit crab, is a species of hermit crab, living in reefs in the Indo-Pacific region from Africa to the South China Sea and Hawaii.
Phyllidia coelestis is a species of sea slug, a sacoglossan, a shell-less marine gastropod mollusc in the family Phyllidiidae.

species.name: Sikatanrimba sulawesi
species.summary: The Sulawesi streaked flycatcher (Muscicapa sodhii) is a small passerine bird in the Old World flycatcher family. It has only been recorded in Sulawesi, where it is known to breed. It appears not to be endangered, being less sensitive to disturbance than many of Southeast Asia's forest-dependent birds.

Argiope aemula adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Argiope dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1842 oleh Walckenaer.

Belenois java, the caper white or common white, is a small butterfly of the family Pieridae found in Australia, Indonesia, and Melanesia. It is highly migratory and is often confused with the cabbage white (Pieris rapae).
Graphium eurypylus, the great jay or pale green triangle, is a species of tropical butterfly belonging to the family Papilionidae.
Papilio demolion, the banded swallowtail, is a species of swallowtail butterfly found in Asia.

Platax boersii, the golden spadefish or Boers’ batfish, is a species of marine ray-finned fish belonging to the family Ephippidae, the spadefishes and bay fishes. This species is found in the Indo-West Pacific.
Appias lyncida, the chocolate albatross, is a butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, which is found in South and South East Asia.
Echinometra mathaei, the burrowing urchin, is a species of sea urchin in the family Echinometridae. It occurs in shallow waters in the Indo-Pacific region. The type locality is Mauritius.
Euploea algea adalah spesies kupu-kupu dalam famili Nymphalidae.
Vindula dejone, the Malay cruiser, is a butterfly from the family Nymphalidae found in Southeast Asia. It is sexually dimorphic.
Trilophidia annulata is a species of band-winged grasshopper in the family Acrididae. It is found in Asia.
Amathusia phidippus, the palmking, is a butterfly found in India and Southeast Asia. It belongs to the Satyrinae, a subfamily of the brush-footed butterflies.
Lauriea siagiani, is a species of squat lobster in the family Galatheidae, genus Lauriea.
Parmarion martensi is a species of air-breathing land semislug, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Ariophantidae.

Trichonephila antipodiana is a species of golden orb-weaver spider in the family Araneidae. Originally described by Charles Athanase Walckenaer in 1841 as Epeira antipodiana, the species was later transferred to Nephila and most recently to the genus Trichonephila in 2019.
Hebomoia glaucippe, the great orange tip, is a butterfly belonging to the family Pieridae, that is the yellows and whites. It is found in the Indomalaya ecozone and Wallacea.
Dolichoderus thoracicus is a species of ant in the genus Dolichoderus. Described by Smith in 1860, the species is widespread in Asia.
Chelidonura amoena is a species of sea slug, or "headshield slug", a marine opisthobranch gastropod mollusk in the family Aglajidae.

Parawixia dehaani adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1859 oleh Doleschall.
Appias zarinda, the eastern orange albatross, is a butterfly of the family Pieridae that is found on Sulawesi and the Maluku Islands, Indonesia.
Pareronia tritaea is a butterfly of the Pieridae family. It is found in Indonesia (including Sulawesi) and the Philippines.
Euchrysops cnejus, the gram blue, is a small butterfly found in India that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.

Creatonotos transiens is a moth of the family Erebidae. It is found in China (Shanxi, Shaanxi, central China, Tibet, Yunnan, Sichuan, Hong Kong, Hainan, Guizhou, Hubei, Hunan, Zhejiang, Fujian), Taiwan, Japan (Ryukyu), eastern Afghanistan, Pakistan, India, Bangladesh, Nepal, Bhutan, Burma, Indochina, the Philippines, B…
Ovula ovum, common name the common egg cowrie, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Ovulidae, the ovulids, cowry allies or false cowries.

Conocephalus melaenus, sometimes known as the black-kneed conehead or black-kneed meadow katydid is a species of Tettigoniidae found in China, Taiwan, Japan, Nepal, India, Indo-China and western Malesia.

Faunis canens, the common faun, is a butterfly from South and South East Asia that belongs to the Morphinae, a subfamily of the brush-footed butterflies. This species may include the Indian faun, Faunis arcesilaus.
Gesonula mundata is a species of short-horned grasshopper in the family Acrididae. It is found in Southeast Asia and Oceania.

Hypolycaena sipylus is a butterfly of the Lycaenidae family. It is widespread in Indonesia as well as occurring in the Philippines and the New Guinea region. It is the type species of the Hypolycaena genus.
Ideopsis vitrea adalah spesies kupu-kupu dalam famili Nymphalidae.
The red-rimmed melania, scientific name Melanoides tuberculata, is a species of freshwater snail with an operculum, a parthenogenetic, aquatic gastropod mollusk in the family Thiaridae.
Monetaria annulus, common name the ring cowrie or gold ringer, is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.

species.name: Kerbau
species.summary: Kerbau, atau yang biasa disebut kebo, benuang atau kerbau air (untuk membedakannya dengan kerbau afrika), adalah binatang memamah biak yang menjadi ternak bagi banyak bangsa di dunia, terutama Asia dan Amerika Selatan.
Ypthima baldus, the common five-ring, is a species of Satyrinae butterfly found in Asia.

Acytolepis puspa adalah sebuah jenis kupu-kupu kecil yang ditemukan di Kamboja, India, Myanmar, Thailand, Yunnan, Sri Lanka, Filipina, Kalimantan dan Papua. Spesies tersebut masuk keluarga Lycaenidae.

Henosepilachna vigintioctopunctata is a species of beetle in the family Coccinellidae. It is commonly known as the 28-spotted potato ladybird or the Hadda beetle. It feeds on the foliage of potatoes and other solanaceous crops. It was previously called Epilachna vigintioctopunctata and is a cryptic species complex.

Nyctemera coleta, commonly known as the Marbled white moth,White tiger moth, is a species of moth found from India to the Philippines, and from Japan to Papua New Guinea. It is classified under the subgenus Coleta of the genus Nyctemera in the family Arctiidae. It contains four subspecies:

Vespa tropica, the greater banded hornet, is a tropical species of hornet found in Southern Asia, new Guinea and west Africa, and which has recently been discovered to be an invasive species on the Pacific Island of Guam. It is a predator of paper wasps.

Lamproptera meges, the green dragontail, is a species of swallowtail butterfly (family Papilionidae) found in parts of South Asia and Southeast Asia. There are ten subspecies. A specimen from Java is the type species of the genus.

Orsinome vethi is a species of orb-weaver spider in the family Tetragnathidae. It has a wide distribution across Asia, being found in India, China, Vietnam, Laos, Malaysia, and Indonesia (including Sumatra, Java, and Flores).

Drain flies, sink flies, filter flies, or sewer gnats (Psychodidae) are small true flies (Diptera) with short, hairy bodies and wings giving them a "furry" moth-like appearance, hence one of their common names, moth flies. There are more than 4,700 known species worldwide, most of them native to the humid tropics.

Papilio gigon merupakan spesies kupu-kupu dari famili Papilionidae. Kupu-kupu ini memiliki sebaran yang terbatas di kawasan kepulauan Indonesia Timur, terutama Sulawesi, Sula dan Talaud, dimana kupu-kupu ini sangat umum ditemukan di kawasan tersebut.
Penthicodes farinosus is a species of planthoppers in the subfamily Aphaeninae (Fulgoridae): with five subspecies distributed in Indo-China and Malesia.
Prosotas dubiosa, the tailless lineblue or small purple line blue, is a species of blue butterfly (Lycaenidae) found in Asia.
Ionolyce helicon, the pointed lineblue, or bronze lineblue, is a small butterfly found in the Indomalaya realms that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Heteractis aurora adalah spesies anemon laut dari famili Heteractidae.
Agrius convolvuli, the convolvulus hawk-moth, is a large hawk-moth. It is common throughout Europe, Asia, Africa, Australia and New Zealand, partly as a migrant.
Nyctemera baulus is a moth of the family Erebidae. It is found from India to Samoa. Records include Queensland, Indonesia and New Guinea.
Xylocopa dejeanii, or Xylocopa (Zonohirsuta) dejeanii, is a species of carpenter bee. It is widely distributed in Asian countries....
Chersonesia rahria is an Indomalayan butterfly of the Nymphalidae family (Cyrestinae). It is found from Manipur and Naga Hills to Burma then from Borneo to Celebes.
Delta pyriforme is a species of potter wasp in the subfamily Eumeninae of the family Vespidae.

Aedes aegypti merupakan jenis nyamuk yang dapat membawa virus dengue penyebab penyakit demam berdarah. Selain dengue, A. aegypti juga merupakan pembawa virus demam kuning (yellow fever), chikungunya, dan demam Zika yang disebabkan oleh virus Zika.

species.name: Belalang Setan
species.summary: Aularches miliaris is a colorful grasshopper belonging to the family Pyrgomorphidae found in South and Southeast Asia. The bright warning colours keep away predators and their defense when disturbed includes the ejection of a toxic foam.

Bactrocera dorsalis adalah jenis lalat buah anggota suku Tephritidae. Lalat buah ini sangat biasa ditemukan di Asia Tenggara, Asia Timur, dan Asia Selatan, dan menjadi pengganggu utama kualitas buah perdagangan di tempat-tempat tersebut.
Cyrestis acilia is a butterfly in the Nymphalidae family. It is found in Sulawesi (Endemic Sulawesi mainland, Buton island, Kabaena island and Wowoni island).

Catopsilia scylla, the orange migrant or orange emigrant, is a species of butterfly that lives in South East Asia and Australasia. Its larvae feed predominantly on plants of the genera Cassia and Senna.
Blanchard's ghost or tree nymph (Idea blanchardii), is a butterfly in the Nymphalidae family.

The longhorn crazy ant (Paratrechina longicornis), also known as "black crazy ant", is a species of small, dark-coloured insect in the family Formicidae. These ants are commonly called "crazy ants" because instead of following straight lines, they dash around erratically.
Bactrocera cucurbitae adalah spesies lalat yang tergolong famili Tephritidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Diptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.
Nacaduba berenice, the rounded six-line blue, is a species of lycaenid butterfly found in Southeast Asia.
Phintelloides versicolor is a species of jumping spider in the family Salticidae. Originally described from Bintan Island in Indonesia, it is widely distributed across tropical Southeast Asia.

Plexippus paykulli adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Plexippus dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1826 oleh Audouin.
Yoma sabina, the Australian lurcher, is a butterfly of the Nymphalidae family. It is found in the north of the Australasia ecozone and Southeast Asia.

Tagiades japetus, commonly known as the pied flat or the common snow flat, is a species of spread-winged skipper butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae. It is widely distributed, being found from India, the Himalayas, Southeast Asia, to Australia. It contains twenty-four recognized subspecies.
Cepora timnatha is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It is found in Indonesia.
Megisba malaya, the Malayan, is a small butterfly found in South Asia. It belongs to the family of gossamer-winged butterflies (Lycaenidae).

Coenobita brevimanus is a species of land hermit crab native to Indonesia called indos crab, the east coast of Africa and the south west Pacific Ocean. Adults of this species can be larger than any other species from the genus Coenobita, weighing up to 0.5 pounds (230 g).

Crossopriza lyoni is a widespread species of cellar spiders that prefer to live in or around human structures. They are commonly known as tailed cellar spiders, tailed daddy longlegs spiders, and sometimes box spiders.
Macroglossum corythus is a species of hawk moth of the family Sphingidae. It was described by Francis Walker in 1856 and is found throughout the Indo-Australian tropics east to New Caledonia.

Actinodendron arboreum, common name the tree anemone and hell's fire anemone, is a species of sea anemone in the family Actinodendronidae. It is native to the Indo-Pacific where it grows at depths of down to 28 metres (92 ft). Most sea anemone species are harmless to humans, but A.
Danaus ismare, the ismare tiger, is a butterfly found in tropical Indonesia. It belongs to the brush-footed butterflies family.
Mycalesis perseus, atau kupu-kupu Dingy Bush Brown, adalah kupu-kupu yang termasuk dalam famili Nymphalidae dan subfamili Satyrinae.
Zemeros flegyas, the Punchinello, is a small butterfly found in South Asia and Southeast Asia that belongs to the Riodinidae family.

Trigoniulus corallinus, sometimes called the rusty millipede, is a species of millipede widely distributed in the Indo-Malayan region including India, Sri Lanka, China, Myanmar, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Singapore, and much of Indonesia.
Liocheles australasiae, the Dwarf Wood Scorpion, is a species of scorpions belonging to the family Hemiscorpiidae.
Monetaria moneta, common name the money cowry, is a species of small sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.

Parthenos sylvia, the clipper, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in South and South-East Asia, mostly in forested areas. The clipper is a fast-flying butterfly and has a habit of flying with its wings flapping stiffly between the horizontal position and a few degrees below the horizontal.
Charaxes nitebis, the green rajah, is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1859. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Thorelliola ensifera is a species of jumping spider of the genus Thorelliola. Originally native to Southeast Asia, it has been widely introduced to tropical islands across the Pacific Ocean.

Catochrysops strabo, the forget-me-not, is a small butterfly found in Asia that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family. It is found in Ceylon, India, from Sikkim to Indochina and in Sundaland, Sulawesi and the Philippines.
Vindula arsinoe, the cruiser, is a butterfly from the family Nymphalidae. It ranges from the Maluku Islands and New Guinea to the Solomon Islands and Queensland. It is sexually dimorphic.
Papilio ascalaphus, the Ascalaphus swallowtail, is a butterfly of the family Papilionidae. It is found in Indonesia and the Philippines.

The Atlas beetle, Chalcosoma atlas (Thai: ด้วงกว่างสามเขาเขาใหญ่) is a very large species of beetle in the family Scarabaeidae, found in Southeast Asia. Males have three prominent horns. The species is named for Atlas, the giant of Greek mythology who supported the skies.

Chlorophorus annularis adalah spesies kumbang tanduk panjang yang tergolong familia Cerambycidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Chlorophorus, ordo Coleoptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.

Cardisoma carnifex is a species of terrestrial crab found in coastal regions from the east coast of Africa and the Red Sea across the Indo-Pacific to the Line Islands and the Tuamotu Archipelago. The range includes parts of northern Australia and the Cocos (Keeling) Islands.
Graphium androcles, the giant swordtail, is a butterfly of the genus Graphium belonging to the family Papilionidae (swallowtails).
Asota caricae, the tropical tiger moth, is a species of noctuoid moth in the Erebidae family. It is found from the Indo-Australian tropics of India and Sri Lanka to Queensland and Vanuatu.
Catopsilia pyranthe, the mottled emigrant, is a medium-sized butterfly of the family Pieridae found in South Asia, Southeast Asia, and parts of Australia.

species.name: Semut Pudak
species.summary: Tapinoma melanocephalum is a species of ant that goes by the common name ghost ant. They are recognised by their dark head and pale or translucent legs and gaster (abdomen). This colouring makes this tiny ant seem even smaller.
Cyrestis acilia is a butterfly in the Nymphalidae family. It is found in Sulawesi (Endemic Sulawesi mainland, Buton island, Kabaena island and Wowoni island).

Gasteracantha kuhli adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1837 oleh C L Koch.
Graphium antiphates, the five-bar swordtail, is a species of papilionid butterfly found in south and southeast Asia. The species was first described by Pieter Cramer in 1775.
Neptis vikasi, the dingy sailer, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in Asia, from north-eastern India to Burma and northern Indochina.
Parantica cleona is butterfly endemic to Indonesia which was described by Hans Fruhstorfer in 1892.

Cethosia cydippe, the eastern red lacewing, is a species of butterfly from Australia, New Guinea and nearby islands. The Australian subspecies, C. c. chrysippe, is known as the red lacewing butterfly.
Charaxes affinis is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Arthur Gardiner Butler in 1866. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Conomurex luhuanus, common name Strawberry conch or Tiger conch, is a species of medium-sized sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Strombidae, the true conchs.

The Common fruit-piercing moth, (Eudocima phalonia), is a fruit piercing moth of the family Erebidae. It is found in large parts of the tropics, mainly in Asia, Africa and Australia but introduced into other areas such as Hawaii, New Zealand and the Society Islands. It is one of major fruit pests in the world.

Pseudosquilla ciliata, the common mantis shrimp, is a species of mantis shrimp, known by common names including rainbow mantis shrimp and false mantis shrimp. It is widespread in the tropical Indo-Pacific region and in both the western and eastern Atlantic Ocean.
Udara dilecta, the prized hedge blue, is a small butterfly found in India, China, and Malaya that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Phalanta alcippe, the small leopard, is a butterfly of the nymphalid or brush-footed butterfly family found in Asia.

species.summary: Euploea hewitsonii, or Hewitson's dwarf crow, is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Cajetan Felder and Rudolf Felder in 1865. It is found in the Australasian realm.

Argiope modesta adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Argiope dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1881 oleh Thorell.

Acherontia lachesis, commonly known as Greater death's head hawkmoth, is a large (up to 13 cm wingspan) Sphingid moth found in India, Sri Lanka and much of the Oriental region, one of the three species of Death's-head Hawkmoth, also known as the Bee Robber.
Asota egens is a species of noctuoid moths in the Erebidae family. It is found from Japan and the Oriental tropics, east to New Guinea.
Catopyrops ancyra, or Felder's lineblue, is a species of butterfly belonging to the lycaenid family described by Cajetan Felder in 1860. It is found in the Indomalayan and Australasian realms.

species.name: Kupu-kupu bidadari
species.summary: Kupu-kupu bidadari atau kupu-kupu sayap renda (nama ilmiah: Cethosia myrina) adalah kupu-kupu dari famili Nymphalidae. Kupu-kupu ini ditemukan di Pulau Sulawesi dan Buton. Lebar sayap kupu-kupu ini adalah 75 mm.

Jamides alecto, the metallic cerulean, is a small butterfly found in the Indomalayan realm but which crosses the Wallace line into the Australasian realm (Celebes). It belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.

species.summary: Remelana jangala, the chocolate royal, is a species of lycaenid or blue butterfly found in Asia.
Lethe europa, the bamboo treebrown, is a species of Satyrinae butterfly found in Asia.
Lyncina lynx, common name : the lynx cowry or eyed cowry, is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.
Melanitis phedima, the dark evening brown, is a species of butterfly found flying at dusk. The flight of this species is erratic. They are found in South Asia.

Cyclosa bifida adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1859 oleh Doleschall.
Cyrestis telamon is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae. It is found in the Malay Archipelago. The larva feeds on Streblus ilicifolius.
Euploea phaenareta, the giant crow is a butterfly in the Nymphalidae family. It was described by Johann Gottlieb Schaller in 1785. It is found in the Indomalayan realm and the Australasian realm.

Grapsus albolineatus adalah salah satu spesies ketam pantai, anggota suku Grapsidae. Ketam ini biasa didapati di tempat-tempat berbatu karang di pantai, dan menyebar luas di perairan Samudera Hindia dan Samudera Pasifik, termasuk pula Kepulauan Nusantara.
Neochera dominia is a moth in the family Noctuidae. It is found from the Indo-Australian tropics from India to Queensland and the Solomons.

Tirumala hamata, the blue tiger, dark blue tiger or blue wanderer, is a butterfly of the Nymphalidae family. It is found in South-East Asia and Australia. In Australia, the butterflies perform mass migrations to the south in some years.
Coenobita violascens is a species of land hermit crab native to the Indonesia, Nicobar Islands, Thailand, Cambodia, Philippines, and Tanzania.

Cytaea dispalans adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Cytaea dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1892 oleh Thorell.
Euploea climena is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Caspar Stoll in 1782. It is found in the Indomalayan realm and the Australasian realm.

Xystrocera festiva adalah spesies kumbang tanduk panjang yang tergolong familia Cerambycidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Xystrocera, ordo Coleoptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.
Lyncina carneola, common name the carnelian cowrie, is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.
Odontoptilum angulata, the chestnut angle or banded angle, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae and is found in Asia.
Tetragnatha hasselti is a species of long-jawed orb weaver spider in the family Tetragnathidae. It has a wide distribution across Asia, from India to China and Indonesia (Sulawesi).
Discophora sondaica, the common duffer, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in Southeast Asia.
Eupanacra elegantulus is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from south-east Asia, including Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia the Philippines.

Euploea eleusina, or Vollenhov's crow, is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Pieter Cramer in 1777. It is found in the Indomalayan realm crossing the Wallace line to Sulawesi in the Australasian realm.

Leptoglossus gonagra, known generally as the passionvine bug or citron bug, is a species of leaf-footed bug in the family Coreidae. It is found in Africa, Australia, the Caribbean, Central America, North America, Oceania, South America, and Southern Asia.

Tirumala limniace, the blue tiger, is a butterfly found in India that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the danaid group of the brush-footed butterfly family. This butterfly shows gregarious migratory behaviour in southern India.
Libythea geoffroy, the purple beak, is a butterfly found in parts of India and Myanmar that belongs to the Libytheinae group of the brush-footed butterflies family.
Mauritia arabica, common name the Arabian cowry, is a species of cowry, a sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.

Nilus albocinctus, synonym Thalassius albocinctus, commonly called the fishing spider, is a species of spider found in tropical Asia from India to the Philippines. It is named after its habit of catching small fish.
Thuridilla lineolata is a species of sea slug, a sacoglossan, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Plakobranchidae. It is an Indo-Pacific species that lives in or near coral reefs and eats algae.
Anthene philo is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It is found in South-east Asia.

Cyrtophora cicatrosa adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1869 oleh Stoliczka.
Lambis lambis, common name the spider conch, is a species of large sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Strombidae, the true conchs.
Neptis columella, the short banded sailer, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in South and Southeast Asia.
Phyllidiopsis xishaensis is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a shell-less marine gastropod mollusk in the family Phyllidiidae.
Psilogramma discistriga is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Bangladesh.
Rhinopalpa polynice, the wizard, is a nymphalid butterfly found in India and South Asia, and is the only species in the genus Rhinopalpa.

Sarasinula plebeia, commonly called the bean slug or the Caribbean leatherleaf slug, is a species of air-breathing land slug, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Veronicellidae, the leatherleaf slugs.

species.name: Susuh Kura
species.summary: Susuh kura (Sulcospira testudinaria) adalah sejenis siput air tawar yang termasuk ke dalam suku Pachychilidae. Siput kecil ini didapati hidup terbatas (endemik) di perairan tawar Indonesia bagian barat.

Symbrenthia lilaea, the common jester, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in South Asia and Southeast Asia. It forms a superspecies with Symbrenthia hippoclus and there are numerous regional forms and the taxonomy of the group is not well resolved.

Amplypterus panopus, the mango hawkmoth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is found in Sri Lanka, southern and northern India (including the Andaman Islands and Nicobar Islands), Nepal, Burma, southern China, Thailand, Vietnam, Laos, Indonesia (to Sulawesi) and the Philippines.

Danaus melanippus, the black veined tiger, white tiger, common tiger, or eastern common tiger, is a butterfly species found in tropical Asia which belongs to the "crows and tigers", that is, the danaine group of the brush-footed butterflies family.
Monetaria caputserpentis, common name the serpent's-head cowry or snakehead cowry, is a species of cowry, a sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.

Psilogramma menephron, the privet hawk moth or large brown hawkmoth, is a member of the family Sphingidae. It was described by Pieter Cramer in 1780. It is usually found in Sri Lanka, India (including the Andaman Islands), Nepal, central and southern China, Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia and the Philippines.
Scolopendra subspinipes (Vietnamese Centipede) is a species of centipede. The native range is uncertain. The certain natural range is Meganesia and Indomalaya.
Zethera incerta, the great Wallacean, is butterfly endemic to the island of Sulawesi in Indonesia. It was described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1869.
The Bicolored Trailing Ant, (Monomorium floricola), is a species of ant of the subfamily Myrmicinae. It is a widespread, invasive ant which is found all over the world.
Papilio euchenor is a butterfly of the family Papilionidae....

Pareronia valeria, the common wanderer or Malayan wanderer, is a medium-sized butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, and is found in India and Southeast Asia. The butterfly found in India is sometimes considered as a separate species, Pareronia hippia.

Diadema savignyi is a species of long-spined sea urchin belonging to the family Diadematidae. Common names include long-spined sea urchin, black longspine urchin and the banded diadem. It is native to the east coast of Africa, the Red Sea, the Indian Ocean and western Pacific Ocean.

Euploea eunice, commonly called blue-banded king crow, is a butterfly found in the Indomalayan realm that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the Danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family.
Luria isabella, common names Isabel's cowry, Isabella cowry or fawn-coloured cowry, is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.
Odontomachus simillimus, is a species of ant of the subfamily Ponerinae, which can be found from many Asian, and African countries.
Papilio fuscus, the Canopus swallowtail, is a butterfly of the family Papilionidae, that is found on Timor, northern Australia, and New Guinea.
Theretra nessus, the yam hawk moth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It was described by Dru Drury in 1773.
Trapezia rufopunctata is a species of guard crabs in the family Trapeziidae.
Asota plana is a moth in the family Erebidae. It is found from the Oriental tropics east to New Guinea.
Celastrina lavendularis, the plain hedge blue, is a small butterfly found in Sri Lanka and South India that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Cepora fora is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It is found on Sulawesi.
Notocrypta paralysos, the banded demon or common banded demon, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.

Leucauge decorata the decorative silver orb spider is one of the long-jawed orb weaver spiders. A medium to large sized orb weaving spider, with a body length up to 12 mm long (female). Male to 6 mm. This species has a "point" to the end of the abdomen. Found in Africa, India, south east Asia, also to Australia.
Stichodactyla haddoni (Haddon's sea anemone), is a species of sea anemone belonging to the Stichodactylidae family native from the Indo-Pacific area.

Thelacantha is a spider genus of the Araneidae family with only one described species, Thelacantha brevispina. The species is closely related to Gasteracantha, and was synonymized with it in 1859, but revalidated in 1974.
Appias albina, the common albatross, is a small butterfly of the family Pieridae. It is found in India, Southeast Asia and Australia.
Leucauge tessellata is a species of spider in the family Tetragnathidae. It has a wide distribution across Asia, ranging from India to China and Southeast Asia.

Maruca vitrata is a pantropical insect pest of leguminous crops like pigeon pea, cowpea, mung bean and soybean. Its common names include the maruca pod borer, bean pod borer, soybean pod borer, mung moth, and the legume pod borer.

Nihonhimea mundula is a species of cobweb spider in the family Theridiidae. It was originally described by Ludwig Carl Christian Koch in 1872 as Theridion mundulum. The species is commonly known as the comb-footed platform spider or rolled-leaf comb-footed spider.
Papilio nephelus is a species of swallowtail butterfly belonging to the family Papilionidae. Subspecies include P. n. chaon, the yellow Helen, and P. n. sunatus, the black and white Helen.

Daphnis hypothous, the jade hawkmoth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae described by Pieter Cramer in 1780. It is known from Sri Lanka, southern and northern India, Nepal, Myanmar, southern China, Taiwan, Thailand, Malaysia, and Indonesia. It is a rare vagrant to the Western Palaearctic ecozone.

The Sulawesi black sailfin lizard (Hydrosaurus celebensis) is a species of agamid native to Indonesia. It is the second largest species of sailfin dragon, with only the Sulawesi giant sailfin dragon being larger, exceeding 1000 mm in total length, possibly 1200 mm.
Actias isis is a moth of the family Saturniidae.
Cassida circumdata is a species of tortoise beetle in the family Chrysomelidae. It is found in Indomalaya and the South Pacific islands.
Catochrysops panormus, the silver forget-me-not, is a small butterfly found from India to the Philippines and south to Australia that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Oxya japonica, also known as the Japanese grasshopper or rice grasshopper, is a species of short-horned grasshopper in the family Acrididae. It is found in Indomalaya and eastern Asia.

Fire ant is the common name for several species of ants in the genus Solenopsis. They are, however, only a minority in the genus, which includes over 200 species of Solenopsis worldwide. Solenopsis are stinging ants and most of their common names reflect this, for example, ginger ants and tropical fire ants.
Thorunna florens is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a shell-less marine gastropod mollusk in the family Chromodorididae.
Tirumala septentrionis atau harimau biru tua, adalah kupu-kupu danaid yang ditemukan di anak benua India dan Asia Tenggara.
Cepora celebensis is a butterfly in the Pieridae family. It is found on Sulawesi.

species.summary: Euapta godeffroyi, the sticky snake sea cucumber, is a species of sea cucumber in the family Synaptidae. It is found on coral reefs in the tropical Indo-Pacific region.
Jamides bochus, the dark cerulean, is a small butterfly found in India that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Lyncina vitellus, common name : the calf cowry or the Pacific deer cowry, is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.
Polyrhachis dives is a wide-ranging species of ant from southern Asia and the Northern Territory of Australia.

Euploea redtenbacheri, the Malayan crow or Redtenbacher's crow is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Cajetan Felder and Rudolf Felder in 1865. It is found in the Indomalayan realm and the Australasian realm.
Nacaduba kurava, the transparent six-line blue, is a species of Lycaenidae butterfly found in Asia.

Theridion zonulatum is a species of comb-footed spider in the family Theridiidae. It was first described by Tamerlan Thorell in 1890. The species is distributed across several countries in Asia, including India, China, Thailand, Singapore, and Indonesia.
Bactrocera umbrosa adalah spesies lalat yang tergolong famili Tephritidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Diptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.
Euthalia amanda, the Sulawesi gaudy baron, is butterfly endemic to Sulawesi, Indonesia. It was first described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1862.
Jamides aratus is a butterfly of the lycaenids or blues family. It is found on Peninsular Malaysia, most of Indonesia and some surrounding islands.
Rapala manea is a butterfly of the Lycaenidae family. It is found in most of the Indomalayan realm (excluding Taiwan).

Deudorix epijarbas, the cornelian, is a species of lycaenid or blue butterfly found in South-East Asia from India to Fiji, including the Philippines, and also the tropical coast of Queensland in Australia.
Discolompa ethion, the banded blue pierrot

Hymenopus coronatus adalah belalang dari hutan tropis Asia Tenggara. Hal ini dikenal dengan berbagai nama umum termasuk belalang bunga berjalan dan belalang anggrek (merah muda). Ini adalah salah satu dari beberapa spesies yang dikenal sebagai belalang bunga dari kemiripan dan perilakunya.

Leucauge granulata is one of the long-jawed orb weaver spiders. Found in India, Sri Lanka, China, Sunda Islands (Indonensia), also to Australia. Leucauge granulata marginata is known to inhabit New Guinea. Leucauge granulata rimitara in French Polynesia.

Myrmarachne clavigera adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Myrmarachne dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1877 oleh Thorell.
Rochia nilotica, common name the commercial top shell, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Tegulidae.
Delias zebuda is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It was described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1862. It is found in the Australasian realm (Celebes, Ternate, Menado).

Eriovixia excelsa adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1889 oleh Simon.
Harpago chiragra, common name the Chiragra spider conch, is a species of very large sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Strombidae, the true conchs.
Charaxes (Polyura) cognatus, the Sulawesi blue nawab, is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Samuel Constantinus Snellen van Vollenhoven in 1861. It is endemic to Sulawesi.

Thyreus nitidulus, commonly known as the neon cuckoo bee, is a parasitic bee of the genus Thyreus, called cuckoo bees. It is a stocky bee, notable for its brilliant metallic blue- and black-banded colors.
Euprotomus bulla, common name : the Bubble Conch, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Strombidae, the true conchs.

species.summary: Radix rubiginosa is a species of air-breathing freshwater snail, an aquatic pulmonate gastropod in the family Lymnaeidae, the pond snails.
Taractrocera ardonia is a butterfly of the Hesperiidae family. It is found in Malaysia, Borneo (Kalimantan, Sarawak, Brunei, Sabah) and southern Sulawesi.

Acrozoanthus is a monototypic genus of soft coral, anthozoans in the family Zoanthidae. It is represented by a single species, Acrozoanthus australiae, which is also known by the common names stick polyp, tree stick polyp, tree anemone, and encrusting stick anemone.

Euploea sylvester, the double-branded crow, also known as the two-brand crow in Australia, is a butterfly found in South Asia, Southeast Asia and parts of Australia that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family.
The Brown-striped semilooper, (Mocis undata), is a species of moth of the Erebidae family. It is found in the Afrotropical and Oriental Regions, including India and Sri Lanka.
Allotinus major, the major darkie, is a small butterfly found in Sulawesi that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.

Catopyrops rita is a species of butterfly belonging to the lycaenid family described by Henley Grose-Smith in 1895. It is found in the Australasian realm and in the Indomalayan realm, crossing the Wallace line.
Erebus crepuscularis is a moth of the family Erebidae. It is found in New Guinea and Queensland.
Mictis profana is a species of insect in the family Coreidae known by the common names crusader bug and holy cross bug. It is distributed in Australia, Indonesia, and the Indo-Pacific.
Naria helvola, common name: the honey cowry, is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.
Viciria pavesii is a species of jumping spider in the genus Viciria. It is the type species of the genus and is found across tropical Southeast Asia.

Kupu-kupu sayap oranye atau Appias nero (Inggris: Orange Albatross) adalah salah satu spesies kupu-kupu dari keluarga Pieridae. Spesies ini bisa ditemukan dari daerah India Utara, kepulauan Sunda, Filipina, dan Sulawesi.
Cepora eperia, the Sulawesi gull, is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It is found on Sulawesi.

Euploea tulliolus, the dwarf crow or small brown crow, is a butterfly found in the Solomon Islands, Malaysia, Taiwan, Vietnam, Singapore and Australia, that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family. It has a wingspan of about 4 to 8 centimeters....
Gasteracantha clavatrix is a species of spider of the genus Gasteracantha. It occurs in Indonesia.
Arhopala araxes is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It was described by Cajetan Felder and Rudolf Felder in 1865. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.

Batocera celebiana adalah spesies kumbang tanduk panjang yang tergolong famili Cerambycidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Batocera, ordo Coleoptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.
Celastrina philippina is a small butterfly found in the Indomalayan realm and which crosses the Wallace Line into the Australasian realm that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Harmonia sedecimnotata is a species of beetle in the family Coccinellidae. The species is found in southern China, eastern India, Nepal and Southeast Asia. The species is predatory.

Phyllodiscus is a monotypic genus of sea anemones in the family Aliciidae. The only species is Phyllodiscus semoni, commonly known as the night anemone, which is native to shallow seas in the central Indo-West Pacific, such as Indonesia, the Philippines and southern Japan.
Vindula erota, the common cruiser, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in forested areas of tropical South Asia and Southeast Asia.
Cepora nerissa, the common gull, is a small to medium-sized butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, which is native to India, China, Southeast Asia, and Indonesia.

Dardanus deformis is a species of nocturnal hermit crab that is found in the Indo-Pacific. Its common name is pale anemone hermit. The species is known to transfer sea anemones from one shell to another when it moves to a different shell. It can be kept in an aquarium.
Erebus ephesperis is a moth of the family Erebidae. It is found in Asia, including India, Japan, the Korean Peninsula, China, Singapore and Borneo.

The Green fruit-piercing moth, (Eudocima salaminia), is a moth of the family Erebidae. It is found from India across south-east Asia to the Pacific Islands. In Australia it occurs in the Northern Territory, Queensland and New South Wales. Adult is a fruit-piercer.
Pergesa acteus, the green pergesa hawkmoth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae described by Pieter Cramer in 1779.
Graphium encelades is a species of butterfly in the family Papilionidae. It is endemic species found only in Sulawesi.

Oriens gola, the common dartlet, is a butterfly of the Hesperiidae family. It is found from Sri Lanka and India (Kumaon, Sikkim, Assam) to Burma, Thailand, Vietnam, Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo and Sumatra. The habitat consists of sunny glades and clearings in secondary forests and plantations.

Cyrtophora exanthematica adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1859 oleh Doleschall.

Eurema celebensis is a small butterfly of the family Pieridae. It is found in the Sula Islands Regency, Indonesia, on the islands of Sulawesi and Sula. It was first described by Alfred Russel Wallace and named Terias celebensis.

The Indonesian giant sailfin dragon (Hydrosaurus microlophus) is a species of agamid native to South Sulawesi Indonesia. It is the heaviest and longest species of sailfin lizard, making it the largest of all the Agamidae. It is often mistaken for H.
Psolos fuligo, the coon, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae. The tips of the forewings diverge outward and is a feature that is clear when they rest on vegetation.
Daphnusa ocellaris, the durian hawkmoth, is a species of moth of the family Sphingidae.
Erronea caurica, common name the thick-edged cowry, is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.

Gasteracantha rubrospinis adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1838 oleh Guérin.

species.name: Manusia
species.summary: Manusia (Homo sapiens) adalah spesies primata yang jumlahnya paling banyak dan tersebar luas. Mereka adalah jenis kera besar yang dicirikan oleh gaya berjalan dua kaki dan kemampuan kognitif yang mumpuni berkat otak mereka yang besar dan kompleks.

Hyllus giganteus adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Hyllus dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1846 oleh C L Koch.

Jamides cyta, the pale cerulean, is a butterfly of the lycaenids or blues family. It is found throughout South-east Asia, from Malaysia to the Solomon Islands and the Philippines, as well as Queensland in Australia.
Papilio polytes, the common Mormon, is a common species of swallowtail butterfly widely distributed across Asia.

Bibasis sena, commonly known as the orange-tailed awl, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae, the skippers. It is also sometimes called the pale green awlet though that name can also refer to Bibasis gomata.

Dichorragia nesmachus, the constable, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in Asia. The genus was earlier considered to belong to the subfamily Cyrestinae and sometimes the Apaturinae, but is now considered as an sister of the genus Stibochiona in the subfamily Pseudergolinae.
Elymnias casiphone is a butterfly in the Nymphalidae family. It was described by Carl Geyer in 1827. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.

Euploea westwoodii, or Westwood's king crow, is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Cajetan Felder and Rudolf Felder in 1865. It is found in the Celebes in the Australasian realm.
Gafrarium pectinatum, also known as Gafrarium tumidum, is a species of the genus Gafrarium in the family of Veneridae, order Veneroida in the bivalve class. They are edible clams.
Libythea narina, the whitespotted beak, is a butterfly found in India that belongs to the Libytheinae group of the brush-footed butterflies family.
Lissoclinum patella is a species of ascidian in the family Didemnidae.

Lysiosquillina maculata, the zebra mantis shrimp or striped mantis shrimp, is a species of mantis shrimp found across the Indo-Pacific region from East Africa to the Galápagos and Hawaiian Islands. At a length up to 40 cm, L. maculata is the largest mantis shrimp in the world. L.

Xanthotaenia is a monotypic butterfly genus in the family Nymphalidae. Its single species is Xanthotaenia busiris, the yellow-banded nymph. They can be identified by a yellow strip along their forewings.
Anthene lycaenina, the pointed ciliate blue, is a small butterfly found in India that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Anthene villosa is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It is found on Sulawesi, the Talaud Islands and the Sangir Archipelago.

Cepora perimale, the caper gull, is a butterfly in the Pieridae family. It is found on Norfolk Island and in New South Wales, the Northern Territory, Queensland, Victoria, Western Australia, Fiji, Irian Jaya, Maluku, Sulawesi, New Caledonia, Papua New Guinea, the Solomon Islands and Vanuatu.

Chelisoches morio, commonly known as the black earwig, is a cosmopolitan earwig in the family Chelisochidae. Black earwigs are active at all times of the day, and prefer wet habitats. Adults can grow up to 36 millimetres (1.4 in).
Euplocia membliaria is a species of moth in the family Erebidae. The species is found from the northeastern Himalaya to Sundaland, the Philippines, Sulawesi and the Lesser Sundas.
Hippotion brunnea is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Indonesia.

The sugarcane looper (Mocis frugalis) is a species of moth of the Erebidae family. It is found in several parts of the world, including India, Sri Lanka, West African countries and other Oriental regions. Adult is a fruit-piercer and a major pest throughout the crops.
Palmadusta asellus is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.
Terinos taxiles is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1862. It is found in the Australasian realm.
Arhopala hercules is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It was described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1862. It is found in the Australasian realm.
Austruca annulipes is a species of fiddler crab found along the coastline from South Africa to Somalia, Madagascar, India, China, Indonesia, Malaysia, and the Philippines.
Bactrocera carambolae adalah spesies lalat yang tergolong famili Tephritidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Diptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.

Carpilius convexus is a species of crab that lives in the Indo-Pacific, from Hawaii to the Red Sea and South Africa. It was first described by Peter Forsskål in 1775 as "Cancer convexus", and has sometimes been treated as a variety of the larger species Carpilius maculatus.

Glyphodes caesalis is a moth in the Crambidae family. It was described by Walker in 1859. It is found in Sri Lanka, mainland India, Burma, the Andaman Islands, New Guinea, Bangladesh, Fiji, Hong Kong, Thailand and Australia (Queensland).
Nacaduba beroe, the opaque six-line blue, is a species of lycaenid butterfly found in South Asia.
Reticulidia halgerda is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a shell-less marine gastropod mollusk in the family Phyllidiidae.

species.name: Ketam Kampat
species.summary: Kepiting kampat atau ketam kampat (Varuna litterata) adalah sejenis ketam pantai, anggota suku Varunidae. Ketam ini umumnya hidup di laut dekat pantai, muara sungai, tetapi juga dapat memasuki perairan sungai berair tawar hingga cukup jauh ke pedalaman.
Badamia exclamationis, commonly known as the brown awl or narrow-winged awl, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae, which is found in India, Southeast Asia, Australia, and Oceania.
Borbo cinnara, commonly known as the rice swift or Formosan swift, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae. It is found in Sri Lanka, India, Burma, Vietnam and Australia.

Carrhotus viduus adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Carrhotus dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1846 oleh C L Koch.

Cephonodes hylas, the coffee bee hawkmoth, pellucid hawk moth or coffee clearwing, is a moth of the family Sphingidae. A widely distributed moth, it is found in the Near East, Middle East, Africa, India, Sri Lanka, Japan, Southeast Asia and Australia.
Clanis pratti is a species of moth of the family Sphingidae first described by James John Joicey and George Talbot in 1921. It is known from Sulawesi and surrounding islands in Indonesia.
Cleora repetita is a species of moth of the family Geometridae. It is found from Sundaland to Australia and the Solomon Islands.
Hasora badra, the common awl, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae, which is found in India.
Hypolimnas antilope, the spotted crow eggfly, is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae. It is found from Malaya to the Philippines, New Guinea and Australia.

Tetragonus catamitus, the common butterfly moth, or Philippine callidulid moth, is a moth of the family Callidulidae. Noted from Taiwan, north-eastern India, south-west India, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Sri Lanka, the Tenasserim Hills of Burma and from Java.
Trapania miltabrancha is a species of sea slug, a dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Goniodorididae.

The fall armyworm (Spodoptera frugiperda) is a species the order of Lepidoptera and is the larval life stage of a fall armyworm moth. It is regarded as a pest and can damage and destroy a wide variety of crops, causing large economic damage.
Stenocatantops angustifrons, the common tropical sharptail, is a species of short-horned grasshopper in the family Acrididae. It is found in Southeast Asia and Oceania.

species.name: Sumpil
species.summary: Subulina octona is a species of small, tropical, air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Subulinidae.

The horehound bug (Agonoscelis rutila) is a stink bug which sucks the sap of the horehound plant, causing wilting of new shoots. They have five nymphal stages in their development. Although they usually attack horehound, they may also swarm on a variety of other trees and shrubs.

Anepsion maritatum adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Anepsion dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1877 oleh O P-Cambridge.
Aoa is a monotypic genus of butterflies in the family Pieridae. The genus and its sole species, Aoa affinis, are endemic to Sulawesi.
Appias aegis, the forest white, is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It is found in south-east Asia.
Arestorides argus, common name : the eyed cowrie, is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.

Argiope halmaherensis adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Argiope dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1907 oleh Strand.
Arhopala acetes is a butterfly endemic to Sulawesi described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1862.
Asota javana is a moth of the Noctuidae family. It is found in Sundaland, the Philippines, Sulawesi and on Sula Island.
Attacus erebus is a moth of family Saturniidae. It is native to Sulawesi (Indonesia). This variety is bred locally and shipped worldwide to butterfly farms.
Erronea errones, the wandering cowry or erroneous cowry, is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.
Gandaca harina, the tree yellow, is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It is found in India, Thailand, Cambodia, Myanmar, Malaysia, Singapore, Philippines, and Indonesia.
Lambis scorpius, common name the scorpion conch or scorpion spider conch, is a species of large sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Strombidae, the true conchs....
Lymantria lunata (luna gypsy moth) is a species of moth of the family Erebidae. It is found in Southeast Asia, from India to the northeast coast of Australia.

Trichomyrmex destructor is a species of ant in the subfamily Myrmicinae. Its common names include destructive trailing ant or Singapore ant. It is a pest species in urban areas, known for causing costly damage to structures, vehicles, and electronic devices with its chewing activity.
Polistes stigma is a species of paper wasp from Southeast Asia.
Rapala dioetas is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It was described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1863. It is endemic to Sulawesi (Sulawesi, Sanghihe, Talaud, Banggai and Salayar).
Tagiades trebellius is a butterfly in the family Hesperiidae (subfamily Pyrginae).
Telicota colon, commonly known as the pale palm dart or pale-orange darter, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.
Agape chloropyga is a species of moth in the family Erebidae. The species is found from Malaysia to eastern Australia, including Borneo and Papua New Guinea.

Apis nigrocincta is a species of honey bee that inhabits the Philippine island of Mindanao as well as the Indonesian islands of Sangihe and the Celebes or Sulawesi. The species is known to have queens with high mating frequencies, the most of any species of the tribe Apini.
Nerita undata is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Neritidae.
Callidula fasciata is a moth in the family Callidulidae. It is found on Ternate.

Cechenena helops is a moth of the Sphingidae family. It is found in Malaysia (Peninsular, Sarawak, Sabah), Indonesia (Sumatra, Java, Kalimantan, Seram, Papua New Guinea), the Philippines (Palawan, Balabac), Nepal, north-eastern India, Thailand, south-western China and Vietnam.

Cyclommatus is a genus of the Lucanidae family, also known as the stag beetle. The majority of the species from the genus Cyclommatus are located in Southeast Asia, though some species can be found in China and Taiwan as well.
Lyssa menoetius is a moth of the family Uraniidae. The species was first described by German entomologist Hopffer in 1856.

Parnara bada, the African straight swift, grey swift or Ceylon swift, is a butterfly of the Hesperiidae family. It is found in south-east Asia, from India through China to Indonesia, as well as the north-east coast of Australia.
Strigoptera bimaculata is the type species in its genus of jewel beetles: in the tribe Polycestini. Distribution records are from south-East Asia.
Sympis rufibasis is a moth of the Noctuidae family. It is found from the Indo-Australian tropics of India, Sri Lanka, Borneo east to New Guinea, the Solomons and Queensland.
Terebellum terebellum, common name the Terebellum conch, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Seraphsidae, the true conchs.
Aloa laetata (red costate tiger moth) is a moth of family Erebidae. It is found in India, Japan, southern and western China, Taiwan, Java, Sumatra, Sri Lanka, Burma and the Philippines.
Angaria delphinus, common name the common delphinula, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusc of the family Angariidae.
Atrophaneura dixoni is a species of butterfly from the family Papilionidae that is found in northern and central Sulawesi, Indonesia.
Canarium urceus is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Strombidae, the true conchs.

The north Moluccan cicadabird (Edolisoma grayi) is a passerine bird in the family Campephagidae that is found on Halmahera, the Bacan Islands, the Tukangbesi Islands and the island of Morotai in the northern Moluccas Islands of Indonesia.

Culex quinquefasciatus Say, 1823 (originally named Culex fatigans), commonly known as the southern house mosquito, is a medium-sized mosquito found in tropical and subtropical regions of the world. It is the vector of Wuchereria bancrofti, avian malaria, and arboviruses including St.
Dardanus gemmatus, the jeweled anemone hermit crab, is a species of hermit crab native to tropical reefs surrounding the Indo-Pacific, typically at depths of 2–100 metres (10–330 ft).
Hasora taminatus, the white banded awl, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae, which is found in Asia.

species.name: eteman
species.summary: Mene maculata, the Moonfish, is the only extant member of the genus Mene and of the family Menidae. The body is highly compressed laterally and very deep vertically. The ventral profile is steep, with a sharp ventral edge. The caudal (tail) fin is deeply forked. The mouth is small and protrusible.
Myopopone castanea is a species of ant in the genus Myopopone. It was described by Smith in 1860.

species.name: Rajungan Biasa
species.summary: Rajungan biasa, rajungan bunga, atau rajungan biru (Portunus pelagicus) adalah sejenis kepiting yang hidup di laut. Jenis ini biasanya ditemukan di wilayah pantai yang dangkal, terutama di perairan Samudra Pasifik bagian barat.
Talanga sexpunctalis is a moth of the Crambidae family. It is found in south-east Asia, including Kolkata, Hong Kong, New Guinea, Thailand and Queensland in Australia.
Terebralia sulcata is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Potamididae.
Adelomorpha is a genus of moths in the family Gelechiidae. It contains the species Adelomorpha ritsemae, which is found on Sulawesi, an island in Indonesia.
Ambulyx celebensis is a species of moth in the family Sphingidae. It was described by Jordan in 1919, and is known from Indonesia.

Celaenorrhinus ficulnea, the velvet flat, is a species of butterfly in the family Hesperiidae. It is found in south-east Asia. The typical form exhibits the white central spot of the forewing above and beneath straightly cut off by the lower median branch. In some taxonomic schemes (e.g.
Papilio veiovis is a species of swallowtail butterfly from the genus Papilio that is found in Sulawesi.
Coenobita cavipes is a species of land hermit crab native to the eastern parts of Africa, the Philippines, China, Japan, Malaysia, Taiwan, Polynesia, and Micronesia.

Lyclene reticulata is a species of lichen moths of the Erebidae family, Arctiinae subfamily. It is found in Queensland, Australia, as well as on Ambon, Seram, Timor, Batchian, Aru, Tobriand, the Louisiade Archipelago and the Dampier Archipelago,
Engina mendicaria, common name striped engina or bumble bee snail, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Pisaniidae.
Ideopsis gaura, the smaller wood nymph, is a species of nymphalid butterfly in the Danainae subfamily. It is found in Southeast Asia.

Iridomyrmex anceps is an ant species of the Iridomyrmex genus. It has a very large distribution in multiple continents, but it is mainly distributed in northern Australia. Some specimens were found in multiple islands, and some were even found and collected in the United Arab Emirates.

species.name: Ketam bulan
species.summary: Matuta victor, atau disebut juga kepiting bulan atau ketam bulan, adalah sejenis kepiting kecil anggota suku Matutidae yang umum dijumpai.

Megacorma obliqua is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Sri Lanka, north-eastern India, Myanmar, south-western China (Yunnan, Hainan), Thailand, northern Vietnam, Malaysia (Peninsular, Sarawak, Sabah), Indonesia (Sumatra, Kalimantan, Java, Ceram, Papua Barat), the Philippines (including Palawan), Papua N…

Pinctada margaritifera, commonly known as the black-lip pearl oyster, is a species of pearl oyster, a saltwater clam, a marine bivalve mollusk in the family Pteriidae. This species is common in the Indo-Pacific within tropical coral reefs.
Tachypompilus analis, the red-tailed spider wasp is a species of spider wasp found in most of tropical and subtropical Asia, north to Japan. These spider wasps often hunt huntsman spiders.

Tropidomantis tenera or Tropidomantis (Tropidomantis) tenera is a species of praying mantis found in Thailand, Malaysia, Sumatra, Java, Flores, Sumba, Sulawesi, Borneo, and the Philippines. Females reach about 2.5 cm in length, and males are smaller....
Vanessa buana, the Lompobatang lady, is a butterfly of the Nymphalidae family found on Sulawesi in Indonesia.
Calappa hepatica is a common benthic species of box crab of tropical and subtropical parts of the Indian and Pacific Oceans and the Red Sea.

Kupu-kupu biblis atau Cethosia biblis adalah salah satu spesies kupu-kupu subfamili Heliconiinae yang termasuk dari famili Nymphalidae. Spesies ini tersebar di bagian timur Anak Benua India hingga ke Asia Tenggara dan Asia Timur. Batas paling timur hingga Filipina dan batas paling selatan hingga Indonesia.
Daphnis protrudens is a moth of the family Sphingidae.

Leucetta chagosensis adalah spesies spons yang tergolong dalam kelas Calcarea. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari filum Porifera, subregnum Parazoa, dan regnum Animalia. Nama ilmiah spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1913 oleh Dendy.
Pelopidas agna, the obscure branded swift or dark branded swift, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.
Udara camenae is a butterfly of the family Lycaenidae. It is found in South-east Asia.
Amblychia infoveata is a moth in the Geometridae family. It is found in Borneo, Peninsular Malaysia and Sumatra.

Charaxes mars, the iron rajah, is a butterfly of the rajahs and nawabs group, i.e. the Charaxinae group of the brush-footed butterflies family. It is endemic to Sulawesi in central Indonesia. Charaxes mars is a large butterfly with forewings with concave outer edge and hindwings each with a tail.
Cnaphalocrocis medinalis, the rice leafroller, is a species of moth of the Crambidae family. It is found in south-east Asia, including Hong Kong, Sri Lanka, Taiwan, Thailand and most of Australia.

Conopomorpha cramerella, the cocoa pod borer, is a moth of the family Gracillariidae. It is known from Saudi Arabia, China, India (West Bengal, Andaman Islands), Thailand, Brunei, Indonesia (Sumatra, Sulawesi, Papua, Papua Barat, Java, Kalimantan, Moluccas), Malaysia (Peninsula, Sarawak, Sabah), Vietnam, Australia, New…
Epepeotes plorator is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae. It was described by Newman in 1842. It is known from Sulawesi and the Philippines.

Euchromia polymena is a moth of the Arctiidae family. It was described by Carl Linnaeus in his 1758 10th edition of Systema Naturae. It is found in India and south-eastern Asia, as well as on Sumatra, Java, Sulawesi, Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo and the Philippines.
Evarcha flavocincta is a species of jumping spider in the genus Evarcha that lives in Asia. The species was first described in 1846 by C. L. Koch.

Pacet macan atau pacet lompat (Haemadipsa picta) adalah sejenis pacet yang berukuran lebih besar (sampai dengan panjang 33 mm) dapat ditemukan di Kalimantan, Indocina, dan Taiwan. Telah dirincikan oleh John Percy Moore berdasar dari spesimen yang dikumpulkan di Sarawak, Malaysia.
Hotea curculionoides is a species of shield-backed bugs belonging to the family Scutelleridae.

Krananda extranotata is a moth in the subtribe Boarmiini of the family Geometridae first described by Louis Beethoven Prout in 1926, from specimens collected in Dutch New Guinea (Irianjaya), in the central Arfak mountains.
Laevistrombus canarium atau yang dikenal dengan nama Siput Laut Gonggong adalah hewan laut jenis kerang-kerangan dengan cangkang halus yang berbentuk gasing oval.

Lamproptera curius, the white dragontail, is a species of swallowtail butterfly native to parts of South Asia and Southeast Asia. It belongs to the dragontails genus, Lamproptera, of the swallowtail (Papilionidae) family. It is not rare.
